title: The School
content: Let me know if you have had this experience - sorry in advance for my poor grammar and walls of text. I will admit Mall World is hard for me to really digest right now. I just found out about it. Here are my experiences: I always get stuck in the school. Generally the school itself is a large campus with multiple baseball, football and track and fields around it. I do recall going through some parking lots towards the back of the school. When you get to the front of the school there is immediately a main office to the right and to the left I have noticed a large library. On the outside of the entrances to both of those places there are two large staircases that wind up to a floor you cannot see. This is where you get to the regular staircases and go to the school floors with classrooms and lockers (these floors seem infinite when I have tried to travel around them). Now back to the main entrance floor, I dont know if anyone else has had this experience but I have seen a way into the basement and the basement itself looks worn down, almost if there was a fire. There are cable lines that look like mechanical pulley systems that I cant seem to understand what they are used for. The basement itself also if you go in enough has a church area. Its like pew seating, grand columns, stained glass windows and the room itself is whire with grey carpeting. The school sometimes have square floors that you can walk around over and over. Often time I have also found stairway hallways with stairs that stop before you can get to the next floor. It almost seems impossible to jump up to them but I can stare at the platform with a halfrailing attatched to the wall at the edge of the platform before you see the open end to a blue door. The bathrooms in it are weird, there are locker rooms that connect to deeper bathrooms that some people cannot access. These bathrooms lead to either closets in hallways or they just get further and further. I often find people doing x-rated things in this bathroom - not sure if anyone has seen weird behavior from other people in their dreams either. There are times I have had to run and hide around the school for a reason unbeknownst to me and only one time was I able to make it up to the attic after jumping up to the platform. The attic itself was full of cluttered junk piled mountain high. I would trudge through this stuff and stop to read books that I could not decipher or had to do with advanced science that I am not versed in. The one time I made it to this attic a man/woman (not nonbinary but seemed dual gendered outside of anything human) came into the attic and told me I wasnt supposed to be there. Then I woke up. When I am in the school I am generally always running from something and make it to the basement or outside where I run to my own childhood home. I have found the further you get into the basement though, the dustier and darker is gets. Almost as if youre choking on dust. I think I have seen more of mall world than just the school but I just discovered Mall World and had to write this down before I forget to come back to it. Has anyone else seen anything like this in Mall World?
